scenes.title: Preparing in Orenlas
scenes.rationale: The party prepares for one planar expedition during its two-day stay; opening table setup supplies framing only.

scenes.title: Through the glass snow
scenes.rationale: Shaping shelter and finding a route through changing Limbo are one travel situation before reaching the orchard.

scenes.title: The Silent Orchard
scenes.rationale: One encounter with the faceless keeper encompasses its rules, memory fruit, recovered recollections, and gifts.

scenes.title: Gravity and the stone wave
scenes.rationale: The teleport complication and stone-wave pursuit remain one journey from the orchard to the sanctuary.

scenes.title: Recovering the lost monks
scenes.rationale: The three circles and subsequent recovery in the cloister form one rescue situation. The written notes extend through the later Rai audience and the audio recap retells earlier play; those overlapping accounts add evidence without adding scenes. Narrate the monastery approach and restoration once.

scenes.title: Rai's divided vigil
scenes.rationale: One continuous audience covers Rai's plea, his attributed explanation, return of the hand, and preparations; the earlier written account corroborates this same meeting.
